content:
Anna P: Hey all — finalizing release notes + internal announce for tomorrow's 09:00 PT change window. Draft of the blurb here: https://docs.internal/release/2026-03-21 (please skim).
Liam: Looks good. Can we call out the model pin and the canary plan explicitly?
Anna P: Yep — proposed copy includes model pin `inference-model@v2.3.1` and canary at 10% for 30m.
Sandeep: +1 on the pin. For rollback, ops runs rollback if error rate >2% or latency p95 increases >200ms vs baseline.
Marisa: Can we add the rollback contact and the short runbook link to the internal announce? Something like: "If quality regression, contact @Sandeep and follow runbook: https://runbooks/release-rollback"
Anna P: Will add. Also planning a short dry-run in #eng-oncall at 08:30 PT so oncall sees the timeline.
DeployBot: :rocket: Deploy scheduled by CI for 2026-03-21 09:00 PT. Canary: 10% for 30m -> 50% -> full. Rollback automated threshold hooks enabled.
Liam: For the release notes section 'what's new' can we include the perf wins (median latency -15%) and the quantization advisory for edge teams?
Anna P: Added a short bullet: "~15% median latency improvement; recommendation: test quantized variant for cost-savings."
Sandeep: Ops note: We'll pin the version at infra level using `pin_service --model inference-model@v2.3.1` before canary. If quick rollback is needed we unpin and `pin_service --model inference-model@v2.2.8`
Marisa: Who's sending the email to internal-announce? I can do it if someone approves copy.
Anna P: Please do, Marisa. I'll post final copy in 15m for approval. Use subject: "[Internal] Redwood: Inference runtime update — 2026-03-21 09:00 PT"
Liam: Tiny nit: change "canary" to "staged canary" in the note to avoid confusion with user-facing feature canaries.
Anna P: Good call, updated.
Sandeep: Ops checklist for the thread (short):
- prepin model at 08:50 PT
- notify ops channel at 08:55 PT
- run quick smoke (5 reqs/s) at 08:58 PT
- start canary 09:00 PT
- monitor p95/errors/throughput for 30m
- escalate if thresholds hit
Anna P: Copying that into the internal announce under "Ops runbook".
Marisa: Approved — sending at 08:45 PT to internal-announce. I'll include the runbook link and the oncall contact.
DeployBot: :white_check_mark: Canary started at 09:00 PT (10%). Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/1234
Sandeep: Monitoring dashboards up. Will call rollback if >2% errors or sustained latency spike.
Anna P: Thanks team — will close thread after send. :raised_hands:
